classification.difficultyReason: Construct a chronological plot then interpret the team ranking, recognising that a smaller position number means a better performance. This adds a routine contextual connection to plotting.

inlines.text: The table below gives the position of a particular football team in a competition of 12 teams at the completion of each round throughout the season.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Represent this information on a time-series plot.

answer.worked: Place round on the horizontal axis and position on the vertical axis. Plot each round–position pair from the table and join consecutive points with straight line intervals.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4 table; teacher PDF page 84, Exercise 18F question 4a
spec.description: Complete time-series plot of all 22 rounds, with increasing numerical position up the vertical axis.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Briefly describe the progress of the team throughout the season.

answer.short: The team generally improved during the first half, stayed mostly in the top five from rounds 7–18, then declined to finish eighth.
answer.worked: A smaller position number means a better ranking. After falling to twelfth in round 2, the team generally improved. It was in the top five throughout rounds 7–18 except for sixth place in round 12, reaching third in rounds 15 and 17. Its position then generally deteriorated over the last five rounds, finishing eighth.
